verdict.rationale: First-party Entra docs confirm users can sign in with a passkey held in the Authenticator app, using biometric or device PIN for phishing-resistant authentication. That doc is framed around Microsoft Entra (work/school) accounts, and nothing in the pack shows everyday users storing passkeys for arbitrary third-party websites and apps. Missing for 10: evidence of passkey storage and sign-in for non-Microsoft websites and apps, consumer-facing passkey setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes

citations.quote: Users can sign in with a passkey in the Authenticator app and complete phishing-resistant authentication with their biometric sign-in or device PIN.
